podcast.body: A 7-inch single for "QYURRYUS" (transcribed as "Kwaiyryos"). The band's recent output has been praised, with Julian Casablancas believed to be doing much better work with The Voidz than in the later stages of The Strokes, especially highlighting its excellent guitar sound. "sale single, Kwaiyryos de The Boots en siete pulgadas, está súper bien, lo que acaban de sacar The Boots."
